correctness.rationale: A unary formula has a unique signed core. Double-negation guarantees parity semantics, and each positive circle core imposes precisely one binary complement constraint on the two evidence bits of its parent. The three formulas are therefore inconsistent. Conversely, assign a core (1,1) only when both evidence bits are demanded, (1,0) for an exclusively positive demand, and (0,1) otherwise. Absence of a forbidden triple ensures every true circle has a classical parent. Structural recursion through all binary formulas extends these choices to a total bivaluation. Every inconsistent theory, including infinite, thus contains a triple. The triple is minimally inconsistent and the checker corroborates all graphs and signed-premise sets through five cores. Finite computations are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 semantics includes the standard inconsistency of an individual circle/explosion triple and proves general proof-theoretic decidability. The independently established converse for all nested unary theories, exact classification of all minimal incompatible sets, finite and infinite three-Helly property, and the linear direct obstruction recognizer are not stated in the inspected principal sources. Broad scientific-index and primary-literature searches did not produce an implication-equivalent theorem. Searches cannot demonstrate absolute novelty; priority under alternate LFI/LET terminology remains a risk.
residual_risks: A logically equivalent exact minimal-premise obstruction result may have been stated in older logics of formal inconsistency or analytic tableau literature under different terminology; indexed searches cannot rule this out.
Direct full text of Antunes et al. (2020) was unavailable; no absence claim is drawn from its limited excerpt.
This theorem is for the unary fragment; allowing binary connectives, or adding propagation/congruence for classicality, changes the proof and possibly the Helly bound.

value.rationale: The minimal evidence logic is motivated precisely by allowing weak contradictions unless classicality is asserted. The natural unary reduct isolates this non-truth-functional interaction. An explicit complete obstruction-hypergraph theorem identifies every minimal incompatible evidence collection for arbitrary nested circles, proves the best possible global three-Helly number and supplies direct linear-time finite theory satisfiability and a three-formula witness, where general full-language tableau decidability was already known. This is a genuine structural classification, not a renamed explosion rule or an arbitrary tiny example.
